messages:
acme_security: Hi team — we're finishing our SIG questionnaire and need final answers + evidence for KMS/HSM usage, audit log retention, and a couple of bespoke items. Due EOD Fri (2026-03-20). Also we saw repeated 401s and latency spikes last week, linking to our compliance review. Can you escalate? Key asks:
• Do you store customer data in logs? retention windows + how to request deletion.
• Exportable audit logs for admin actions (format, retention).
• KMS/HSM: where keys live, BYOK support, attestations/certifications.
Also: we have API repro steps for 401 + a short billing discrepancy. Attaching screenshots in drive: https://drive.acme/cs/qa
Please advise owner.

emma_cs: Thanks @acme_security — filing as an urgent escalation. @dylan_security can you take the KMS/audit answers? @marta_support can you triage the 401 + billing repro? I'll coordinate due date.

dylan_security: On it. Quick answers up-front: we don't persist customer plaintext in logs by default (we redact tokens/keys). Audit logs are exportable as JSON/CSV via the Console or API, retention 90 days by default for hosted, longer for enterprise. For HSM: we support BYOK via customer KMS (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault) and optional HSM-backed KMIP in private deployments. Need to gather attestation docs (SOC2 + HSM vendor certs). I'll attach links.

dylan_security: Evidence I can provide:
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) link
- HSM vendor cert + key management whitepaper
- Console screenshot showing 'Export Audit Logs' (need ops help to generate instance export)
Need confirmation from infra on the export payload format (fields) and retention for this ACME org.

marta_support: Repro steps for the 401s — got them from ACME logs. Short repro:
1) POST /v1/generate with header Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
2) After ~200 requests in ~30s they see intermittent 401 with trace id `trace-7a9b2`
3) Example response:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{
  "error": "invalid_token",
  "trace_id": "trace-7a9b2"
}
```
I ran a quick check, token still valid, likely a throttling/auth cache expiry edge. @sanjay_eng can you check token validation path & auth-cache TTLs?

sanjay_eng: :wave looking. I pulled the backend traces for `trace-7a9b2` — shows token validation succeeded upstream but failed at auth middleware during a 503 from the auth provider (timeout). That correlates with the latency spike window 2026-03-12 14:02-14:06 UTC. Root cause may be our fallback logic treating provider timeouts as invalid token for some flows. I'll add this to a hotfix. ETA: patch + deploy in next 24h. Meanwhile can we add a mitigation (retry/backoff) for the customer?

emma_cs: ACME asked about billing discrepancy they saw — an unexpected invoice line for 'burst compute' on 2026-03-12. @marta_support can you pull the usage report and map to the latency window? If the backend retried, that may increase billable tokens.

marta_support: On it. Pulling usage now. FYI the customer's Dedicated plan has burst enabled; I'll prepare a line-item breakdown and a short note re: retries. Estimated prep time 2 hours.

dylan_security: For the questionnaire fields that require precise wording, here's proposed text you can paste into SIG/CAIQ answers:
- KMS/HSM: \"Redwood supports customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, GCP KMS) and offers HSM-backed key storage options for Private deployments. Keys used to encrypt customer data at rest are not exported by Redwood. BYOK flows use standard envelope encryption and integrate with customer KMS policies.\"
- Audit logs: \"Audit logs capture admin actions and system events; exports are available via console/API in JSON/CSV. Default hosted retention is 90 days; Dedicated/Private retention is configurable. Customers may request extended retention or on-demand exports.\"

acme_security: Thanks — that's helpful. Two follow-ups:
1) Can we get a short export of sample audit log lines (sanitized) for the 'delete model' and 'api-key rotate' events?
2) Where do we find the SOC2 & HSM certs? I need to attach them to our portal.

dylan_security: I'll generate sanitized sample exports. For SOC2/HSM certs: link (internal) sent via secure drive — will share a public redacted copy. @emma_cs please approve before sending to ACME.

deploy-bot: deploy v0.92.7-hotfix-auth applied to staging at 1769501285 — rolling to prod after smoke tests.

sanjay_eng: Hotfix rolled to prod at 1769501290. Preliminary metrics show auth timeouts reduced in the window we saw. Will monitor for 12h.

emma_cs: :thumbsup: I'll assemble the packet (questionnaire answers, sanitized logs, SOC2 redacted link, billing breakdown draft) and send to ACME by EOD Fri. @acme_security do you want an official support call before submission?

acme_security: Yes please — a quick 30min runthrough tomorrow morning (2026-03-19 09:00 PT) would be great. Thanks everyone.
